# DraftedChangeView

## Rules
- Extends `ReadOnlyChangeView`. Extra: `isDrafted` MUST be `true`.
- No public unwrap to mutable `Change` (same as read-only-change-view).
- Construct only via ChangeRepository / GetDraft using `toDraftedChangeView`. Callers: `getDraft`, `listDrafts`, `GetDraft.execute` — not arbitrary in-memory Change.
- Artifact body via ChangeRepository.artifact with drafted storage context — not on view type.

## Constraints
- Narrowed projection for drafted storage, not Change replacement. Terminology: Draft/Drafted (not "shelved").
